message.content:
This vertical rectangular cover for Tempo magazine features a white background with a red vertical border on the left. At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is printed. Below it, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small, black capital letters.

The central figure is a large, black, scribbled illustration of a person's head and neck. The face is heavily bandaged around the eyes and top of the head, with only the lower face and a beard visible. The entire head is composed of dense, chaotic, overlapping black lines that extend outwards like thorns or messy hair.

In the upper-right corner, two realistic human hands enter the frame. The right hand appears to be pulling a single thin black line away from the scribbled head.

To the left of the head, large red text reads "MENCARI PENYERANG NOVEL BASWEDAN". Below this, a block of smaller black text begins with "Tempo melacak jaringan...".

At the very top, two headlines are separated by a diagonal line: "GERILYA SELEKSI KOMISIONER OJK" and "LAPORAN DARI MARAWI: JEJAK KLAN MAUTE". At the bottom right, there is a date "12-18 JUNI 2017", price "RP 45.000", and a barcode.
